issues.where: the pool on the right where it meets the sand bench
issues.what: the water is a cut box: a flat vertical wall of blue-white texture and a hard rectangular blue volume with a straight vertical edge, no shore, no wet edge, no meniscus
issues.fix: give the water a real shoreline that meets the sand at its surface, with darkened wet sand, and remove the visible volume walls

issues.where: the left water sheet and the far lake
issues.what: two reflection planes at different heights overlap; the left sheet floats above the sand showing an inverted cliff and a sky band with a straight horizontal cutoff, so the water has no depth and the cliff reflection is doubled
issues.fix: use one water surface at one height, reflecting once, with the bed fading into depth beneath it

issues.where: the ring ripples and dome in the mid water
issues.what: the ripples are thin perfect white concentric lines with tiny pins standing on them, and the centre is a smooth dome with orange-brown stripes; it reads as a CG primitive, not disturbed water
issues.fix: replace with a real displacement of the surface, soft ripple troughs that bend the reflection, and drop the line rings and pins

issues.where: the two long-necked animals in the foreground
issues.what: smooth untextured clay model look, same pose and same model duplicated, no wet, dust or salt on them, no contact or shadow on the water or ground
issues.fix: vary pose and scale, add skin detail and wet or dusty legs, and ground them with contact shadow and ripples where they stand

issues.where: the skeleton and loose bones on the sand
issues.what: bones are smooth glossy orange cylinders and spheres, uniform in colour, sitting on the sand with no burial, shadow or weathering
issues.fix: model bones with bleached, cracked, part-buried surfaces and contact shadow

issues.where: the near sand and lake bed, left and centre foreground (crops x0-17 y58-75, x42-58 y58-75)
issues.what: texture is stretched into long orange streaks and smeared, with a blurred noisy grain at close range; it reads as a projected map, not sand
issues.fix: use a close-range sand material with proper scale ripples and grains, no projection stretch

issues.where: the cliff reflection in the lower right water (crop x83-100 y58-75)
issues.what: the reflected rock is smeared into horizontal stretched bands with repeating streaks, like a stretched wood texture
issues.fix: render a true reflection with ripple distortion instead of a stretched texture

issues.where: the upper frame, the far cliff behind the haze
issues.what: the far wall is a flat noisy textured plane with a hard straight horizon line under it, no sky and no aerial depth; the haze is a flat grainy tint
issues.fix: give the far wall form and distance falloff, a soft horizon, and haze with light in it

issues.where: the far shore band across the frame (crops y25-42)
issues.what: the far land is a flat strip with straight hard parallel edges top and bottom, like a stacked set of planes; the water below it is a flat brown with no reflection
issues.fix: break the shoreline into a natural irregular edge and let the water reflect the far shore and sky

issues.where: the cliff reflection on the right (crop x83-100 y25-42)
issues.what: the shadowed areas of the reflection are pure black, with no sky fill
issues.fix: lift the shadows with sky light and water colour

issues.what: dark round arch holes repeat at similar size across the wall, and the strata are one material everywhere
issues.fix: vary the cave openings and the rock material
